snippet.title: Ravage Fist V0.2 - Trailer
snippet.description:
"Tereon" the Galactic Demon King, and his gargantuan bodyguard "Gorak" the Alien Golem, came to invade our planet, and if we want to fight back, we have to enter to his martial arts tournament, dubbed "The Stellar Tournament". Only the boldest of the shonen warriors, magical girl heroines, and prehistoric 70's cheap monsters can accept this challenge!!!

This game is getting better with the time. Pls support this project!!!
